text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bellache Messaoud, a driver working for El Moudjahid, was assassinated in Algiers.
- Air Algerie to resume flights to Paris in April. The Algerian airline suspended operations to the French capital in 1995 over a security row with Paris airport authorities.
- Leila Asslaoui, a leading anti-Islamist figure, backs union leader Abdelhaq Benhamouda who plans to set up a political party.
- The Transitional National Council to hold an extraordinary session on January 25.
- The authorities plan to step up privatisation of state-owned companies.
